dogecoin.text:
You ask yourself...
"Why didn't I go all in dogecoin back in 2018?"

You get home and look at your mail, sigh that the electricity bill is going up to 50 dogecoin a month. As you look at your kid working on his homework, you take pride in him and wish that you could give him the best life possible. At which point that regret dawns on you.

A nice yellow Lamborghini Dogeciélago drives by, you wish you could afford it but it will be over 50K Doge! You type in the coordinates for Starbucks and get driven there for a Dogesso, it will cost 0.1 Dogecoin.

$doge #dogecoin Who wrote this in 2018?
The year is 2030.
You walk out from your apartment and go to the car sharing office down below. You pick out a Tesla Model D OGE edition and swipe your DogeCard in the door, it will cost 2 Dogecoin for 1 day of use.
